en.basel-kadem: 104.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said:

We were told by Ahmad bin Idrees, from Muhammed bin Ahmad, that he said: We were told by Abu Abdillah al-Razi, from Hasan bin Hussain, from Yasin al-Dhareer, or another, from Hammad bin Isa, from Ja’far bin Muhammed, from his father, peace be upon them both, that he said:
A sought marriage from a people, and they said: What is your trade? He said: I sell riding animals.

Then, they conducted in marriage with him, and suddenly, it was observed that he sells fishing tackles. So, they brought the case to dispute before Ali bin Abi Talib, peace be upon him, and he declared his marriage as permissible, and he said: Fishing tackles are (an application of) riding animals.
